message.content:
The task was to find Google Maps’ “Search settings” page and report what options are shown there.

The result shows the Google Search settings page opened from Google Maps, with the left navigation containing “Privacy & Safety” and “Other settings.” The screenshot specifically confirms the “Other settings” page, showing:

- Language and region
- Dark theme — Device default
- Results in a new window — Off
- Spoken answers — On
- Auto-complete with trending searches — On

The result response also reports the “Privacy & Safety” options as:

- Search customisation — On
- SafeSearch — Blurring on
- Parental controls on Family Link

Although the screenshot only visually confirms the “Other settings” section, the response provides the remaining options, and per the evaluation instruction, content not shown in the screenshot can be accepted if stated in the response.

Overall, the requested page was found and the options shown on it were reported.

Verdict: SUCCESS
